title: rpt scope record
description: One in-scope asset, a row of scope.csv. Schema version 3. Other CSV columns appear as extra string members; no column may be named kind or lines.

rev.description: The row's revision, over scope.csv's header and the row's own text: edits to other rows leave it alone. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the row changed since this read.
